title: Museum of the Great Patriotic War
summary: The Museum of the Great Patriotic War refers to various history museums established in [[soviet-union|the Soviet Union]], focusing on the Eastern Front during World War II, with significant relevance to [[ukraine|Ukraine]]'s historical narrative.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Museum of the Great Patriotic War is a term that encompasses several history museums dedicated to the events of the Eastern Front during World War II.

sections.heading: Notable Museums
paragraphs: One prominent example is the Museum of the Great Patriotic War located in Moscow, which serves as a major national site commemorating the conflict.
Another important institution is the Belarusian Great Patriotic War Museum, which also focuses on the war's impact on the region.

sections.heading: Ukrainian Context
paragraphs: [[coal-in-ukraine|In Ukraine]], the [[national-museum-of-the-history-of-ukraine-in-world-war-ii|National Museum of the History of Ukraine in the Second World War]], previously known as the Museum of the Great Patriotic War in [[kyiv|Kyiv]], plays a crucial role in documenting and interpreting the country's experiences during the war.
